text: Didn't plan on this place as a destination... but we were walking past and I heard the most wonderful rendition of Ray Charles' Georgia and we just had to go in. Let me tell you folks, YOU NEED TO TRY THIS PLACE .. the food was fantastic and the music was phenomenal... Blues For The City was the band playing and I just can't say enough great things about them.  We normally don't do "chain " places but man was this great! I had one of the best nights I have ever had in NOLA and I have been many times. Band cover was $5 and food prices were reasonable... our server was top notch with a full house.  please try this place. You won't be sorry. I will visit this place from now on.
Stopped by to get a quick bite to eat!!! Michelle & Betty were amazing!!!! Thanks for the food & laughter!!!

OMGoodness!!!

My honey and I stopped in for lunch recently and I ordered the sweet potato chipotle bowl.  It blew my mind.  

There was sweetness thanks to the sweet potatoes, there was heat thanks to the chipotle peppers, there was texture thanks to the pepitas, and the crema cooled it all down. Yall, this bowl was everything!   

A moment for the sweet potato chipotle bowl please.....

I'll be back.

Came here a couple times while my MIL was in the hospital down the road. This place gets PACKED so come early if you can. Their food is delicious and their waiters are extremely friendly. But we do have a couple complaints. The bathroom had several roaches crawling around which really grossed me out, luckily for them, I saw it right before we paid the bill. 
We also placed an order online one day, showed up to pick up the order only to find out they hadn't even started because their system didnt actually show the order. Not sure if that was a glitch or what but it cost us over an hour of our time. We would've gone somewhere else but the money had already been taken off our card from the website. Hope they can get that figured out and fixed.
Loved this place. Ate here 3 times on weekend trip. Lots of variety.  Pizza and salads are delicious.

21 Health Code Violations

This location has always had failure attached to it dating back to the Moody Monkey. While on Instagram, an ad popped up about West Norriton Diner but it was actually an ad by the PA Department of Health. It was about a recent health inspection and how West Norriton Family Diner had 21 violations including rodent droppings and dead rodents. Yuck. Had food here once, wasn't good. Won't ever come back again after reading the health code violations.
food and service were good. shrimp mofongo was very good. Crab balls were very tasty.
Love the quality of their food.  Have had the brisket and macaroni and slaw several times.  Sauces are good.  I think they are a bit over-priced.

Food was great but the service was phenomenal! My bf and I are in town visiting and we got T as our server and she was just great. Had her recommendations for the fried grit cakes (bomb), hot chicken and cheddar, mac n cheese, and the loaded frozen lemonade (pineapple and prickly pear)~ all were fantastic. Had the tacos as well which were good but T really broke down the menu and gave us the best recs and exceptional service! Will be back before we leave for sure!
Y'all did me dirty. I left my house, happy go lucky to get some Taco Bell, and little did I know, my day would turn upside down. If I could leave no stars, I would. Very unfortunate.
This sweet little business left me with a happy little smile, the breakfast was amazing! Genuine experience, got a cute little sticker at the end of our visit :) five stars always

One of the worst Mexican places I've ever eaten at. The food was bland and tasteless. The decor was old and depressing looking. The restaurant was dead other then us and one other party. I don't recommend!

The perfect foodie restaurant! Livery's menu is full of delicious items and you can't go wrong. My favorite is the canelones which are served in a cast iron pan. The dish is filling and full of flavor in every bite. I adore their white sangria which is served in the summer and is a seasonal item. This time I had their red sangria which was super delicious and part of the winter menu. They have beautiful rooftop seating which makes for the perfect date night ambiance. I have been here for birthday dinners, cinco de Mayo, and Devour Indy. Every time I am always impressed and leave super full and content. They also serve these fantastic little crunchy chicharones at the table when you get there too. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a unique and fun dinner! Anyone who genuinely enjoys trying new foods will love this place!

Please please please don't even think of trying out this restaurant. Horrible food!!! 

Got some food worth 200$ for my my birthday party last night and none of my guests ate anything (it was that tasteless!!!). Can't believe I drove 9 miles for this crappy food.  

Called the owner the next day and guess what the owner accuses you of lying instead of understanding the situation. He even laughs at you when you try to explain him what went wrong. During the entire conversation he kept accusing me of not calling him the other night and even suggests you to not WARM up the food telling you it stays warm for 2 hours. Like seriously now we as a customer don't even have a say on if we want to warm up our food!!!


Appetizer:
1 Chicken Tikka: LOL, seems more like boiled chicken with so much gravy.
2. Chicken pepper fry: Humble request they need to put it under the entree. We even mistook it for chicken curry, since when did CPF become like a curry???

Entree:
1 Chicken tikka Masala: ordered 2 of these, Sour sour sour not even close to a CTM.
2.Chicken Vindaloo: basically it's a chicken curry and again sour. Humble request to the owner either rename it to chicken curry in the menu or take it off.

The first thing I did was call him in the morning and even asked him if he wants to see the pictures or if he could take the food away. But he keeps trying to lure you into getting it cooked again. Like after such a horrible experience, do you expect me to try your food again??? 

Regardles
Great ambiance loved the food and friendly staff. Great date night or birthday dinner setting.

I have been wanting to try this restaurant since March when quarantine started and they closed, my reservation was canceled. It was most definitely worth the prolonged wait! 
My friend and I went for his birthday. It is a great restaurant to celebrate a special occasion. 
I highly recommend the brick chicken which was juicy and flavorful. I also recommend the S'more Pot De Creme. It is a dessert meant for 1 and is worth every bite. Loved the ambiance, loved the food, and great service. This is a So bro must go!

I recently moved to the area and have found most meals acceptable but bland.  Mio's is a pleasant exception.  The spinach Borka were delightful with an excellent accompanying Tzatziki sauce.   The Beef Gyro salad also gets high marks.  I'll be back for sure.

Best Goat in Nashville! I love this place. Small and Intimate! Nice outside patio seating! When u smell the smoke coming from the grill outside u should come running. Food is fresh and you get alot of food for your money! I have had the goat, fish, and the chicken and they are all great! Plantains and other sides are great as well. This food will touch your soul!!

Most beautiful, unique hotel we have ever had the pleasure of staying in.  Room was very large as well as the bathroom.  Very nice amenities, delicious food, incredible rooftop views that are second to none.  Even the music that was being played fit the space every single time and added to an incredible atmosphere.   Evan Marx was a perfect host, had everything set up for us, and it was nothing but smooth.  Entire staff team we met was wonderful. We felt like we were treated like a King and Queen for our whole stay! We will be back! Highly, highly recommend.
Great time, cooking demo had a lot of great information and the food was really good.

No customer service at all. Very disappointed after hearing how good it's suppose to be. Went in for lunch, no one greeted me, which is fine...i asked what type of slices they and was told to go to the line where they make the pizza. Not a problem, got in that line, I was the line...no one one else was inside except for me and not on how can I help you, what would you like...just two associates chatting and a manager doing what appeared to be stacking pizza boxes. Maybe this is just a hobby and they aren't in it to make a living. Best wishes though.
Why did you stop serving the crunchy rice salad? Please bring back.

Tried Peel for the first time.  They have lots of interesting and different combinations for their pizzas (each of which are about 12").  My favorite was the Thai Curry Pizza.  My meat loving family ordered the Trio, but it was very average.  The thing about this pizza is that the crust is too thin to hold up to all the ingredients and it really doesn't get that good wood-fired taste to it.  The buffalo wings were great.  We also had an order of the boneless wings, but they were just like breaded chicken nuggets and it didn't really get the flavor of the sauce we chose.   Glad we tried it, but too many other great places to go to to be back again.

Hosted our 30th class reunion there for a private party. Food was great and bartenders were super friendly. Great place for lunch, meeting friends or stopping for a nice glass of wine. This is a gem in Belleville!

Chick-Fil-A is a staple fast food joint for me! I recommend their Grilled Chicken Market Salad if you are looking for a healthier option. Fast and friendly service. Only downside is that they are closed on Sundays!

Fun casino if a bit out of the way from downtown Reno and all the bigger casinos. 

Wide variety of slots including dragon link, lighting link and Dancing Drums. Of course older slots and various forms of Buffalo slots are here too.  It's where locals come to play without dealing with too many tourists. 

Plenty of open parking and the RTC Number 7 bus is right in front. 

Parts of the casino is kind of dark though. And yes, you have to make a reservation for their restaurant. 

Edit: Spotty WiFi. At the last minute, either they turned it on or they rebooted their router. :)

They also have a gift shop usually not found at some independent casinos.
Their Sunday brunch is delicious!! A must for anyone looking for delicious breakfast and even gluten free biscuits and gravy!!

We stopped in with our kids for a quick bite. The cheeseburger was huge, so our kids shared it. The kids said it was delicious. Hubby and I shared an order of wings . .   they were crispy and delicious. Very meaty and the sauce was not super spicy. Very good. The live music was also very good.
We LOVE this place!  Best horchata and food around!

I've been here a handful of times pre-Covid for a fun night out with friends, but recently I went with three girlfriends to celebrate a friend's birthday, and it was my first time trying the food. I didn't have crazy expectations, but I ended up being pleasantly surprised at how good their classic burger and fries with gravy was! Love that they carry Murphy's stout as well. Our waitress was friendly and provided good service. I like the ambiance of the place and will be back.

Worst part of our trip to New Orleans so far. Drink prices were outrageous.It was seven dollars for kids chicken tenders. Got two dry chicken tenders and took 35 minutes to cook. $15 for grilled po boy sandwiches, were good except I would expect a lot more shrimp on it for being New Orleans. Total tourist trap. Save your time and save your money.

We waited 45 minutes and then they were out of nearly everything... the list of what they were out of was 15 different main dishes or most of their menu.  We had overheard others talking about them running out of things but assumed it would be two or three things.  The staff made no attempt to communicate this fact to the 15-20 people waiting for tables. Very disappointed. Terrible service.  Probably won't go back here. Too bad it is run so poorly.
One of our favorite Italian restaurants to visit in the area. The dishes taste homemade and it feels like you're eating quality tasty meals.

This place is a gem! Great food and service. I've been looking for a good seafood place in Tampa, and this is definitely one of them. I especially want to point out the great service I received when I visited. Kim (or Ngan, she supposedly goes by both) was AMAZING!
Great dive bar. Great food. Interesting patrons. We stayed at the Roosevelt across the street. I enjoyed this placw more than Dickie Brennan's.

Ok-I don't usually think of Tucson as my go to Chinese noodle city but this place may just change my mind. We went there twice in a week and I would have gone more if our schedule had allowed. I will admit I did think about them almost every day. We had the dumplings which were a tasty snack starter. The Guilin spicy sour is my personal favorite. It's everything I want in a bowl of noodles. All the flavors and all the noodles. It is more on the adventurous side with the funky pickled veggie in it but not gonna lie that is my favorite part. The Taiwan beef is perfect as well-beefy, flavorful and bold. The Sichuan spicy will give you that flower pepper hot pot numbing spice that I love too. 

Ambiance-it's cute and totally friendly to a first foray in noodle land. The owners are super nice. Order a Hong Kong milk tea too!

Mocha Coconut, my spoiled pup enjoyed his soft serve ice cream and his little bone treat so that means this place gets five stars.

Twistee Treat is needed in this area. There is nothing really close except for Dairy Queen which may not be the cleanest. This location is newly constructed. It is a walk up window or even a drive through with a good amount of tables.  There are even games for the kiddos.

Happy to have this location in the area. My dipped cup was very good and can't wait to have a banana split here!
What an amazing little restaurant, great outdoor seating , friendly and helpful staff , great chef , my steak was delish

Came here for breakfast and the food was AMAZING...VERY fresh. The orange juice I got tasted extremely fresh and natural and the vegetables tasted VERY organic. Amazing food. Service was great and very friendly waitress

Small pretzel shop that makes massive pretzels, regular sized pretzels, pretzyl bites, and pretzyls that are stuffed with everything from hot dogs to philly cheese-steaks. 

Their regular pretzels are weirdly shaped 

Make all cheese sauces in house, but also offer mustards. 

They also offer breakfast pretzels and are in the midst of launching a line of dessert pretzels

My second favorite pizza in Florida over the past nearly five years of moving here. 
Why four stars? The price / portion. I don't care if the Vatican blessed this pizza and I understand quality ingredients but you are paying for a franchise. 
The calzone also was suppose to have ricotta, after dissecting every knife/fork portion I did not see any. The side sauce was amazing with three large cloves of garlic. 
I will go back for sure. Just need a raise first.

We ordered lobster bisque and a salad to be delivered, and were so pleased!  The salad was very large and delicious, with ample toppings and chicken on the side.  The lobster bisque was unbelievable!  So, so good. The delivery option made it really convenient, especially during the quarantine. We will definitely order again!!!!

I am a sucker for Middle-eastern and Mediterranean food! The combo of grilled meats, flavorful rice, and fresh herbs and salads pretty much always knocks my appetite out cold! Well...consider me KO'd cuz Taziki's hit the SPOT! 

My go-to is the grilled chicken feast. Perfectly grilled chicken, savory basmati rice, and a crisp and fresh Greek salad! I also love their Taziki sauce so much I usually ask for an extra! I liked it so much that I hired them to cater my next office lunch and they where fantastic to work with! The only downside was there weren't any leftovers!

I will occasionally grab a slice or two when I'm desperate, which I have to doctor up at home. In general the food is mediocre at best and they don't seem to care. It's a shame because with minimal effort it could be decent. And by minimal effort I mean seasoning, cooking things correctly/thoroughly, and not using shitty ingredients.

The service here is wonderful. The man at the desk was very nice and welcoming! The food lacked a little, however. The beef noodle soup in Thai style had little taste. I recommend buying the Drunken Noodle dish and the Green Curry (meat choice: chicken) because these two plates were delicious.
Something about their Thai dishes always mess up my stomach. I've tried 3 times but it doesn't seem to agree with me. The food tastes okay, but that's where the fun stops for me. Yes, TMI.

I have to say they have really upped their game lately. For a while pre-covid I'd given up on Margaret and dined exclusively at Dim-sum- mania across the street. A few months ago we gave Margaret a try again for take out and it was really very good. I had forgotten how wonderful the cooking used to be here. 

We ordered Velvet chicken soup, seafood hot and sour soup, the home style tofu, chow fun, and double pork,  and everything was hot, fresh and delicious.

We look forward to heading back when masks can come off. It's a bit more expensive than the dim sum across the street but it's larger portions and great taste.
TRY THE BLOODY MARY with bacon infused vodka SO GOOD. Also the coffee is really good too

One of the nicer Chipotle's I've been to in Philadelphia. Lots of seating, very clean, and nice ambient lighting.

Went here a little after 6pm. There was no line when I got there but by the time I sat down there was a line almost to the door. Seems like one of the popular restaurants out of all the choices in this plaza.

I got a carnitas bowl. Everything was perfect except the white rice was undercooked. I like brown rice but I avoid ordering brown rice when I go out since it's almost always undercooked because of how long it takes to cook it compared to white rice. But this time even ordering white rice didn't prevent me from getting undercooked rice. :( 


Everything was 5/5 stars otherwise but undercooked rice sucks

Came here with my brother after a preds game. We hadn't been here and wanted to check it out. 
It was a weekday, so it wasn't too packed. They're gonna card you at the bottom of the steps.  
The place is cute and a typical bar on broadway. I will say I was drawn off, because it smelt like a dirty wet mop. Gross. 
I didn't have any drinks, but I liked that there were two bars. The main bar in the middle and one off to the side.  There's plenty of room to dance and a pretty hefty stage up front. The decor is cute too. 
I loved the seating along the left side and the little tables. We didn't go out on the rooftop part, but it'll probably be a good space for the summer.
One of those places that cannot be bothered to update their operation hours on major platforms such as Yelp, Apple Maps, or Google maps.

Good food but with manager and staffing issues.

Waitress was over sat and had seven tables. We got our entrées about five minutes after our appetizers, which made for a crowded table. I enjoyed the appetizers, but when I finally looked at my crispy onion barbecue burger, I noticed I didn't have any crispy onions. After waiting about 15 minutes for the waitress to come back, I also noticed that my burger was well done even though I ordered it medium.

The waitress told me that my burger usually doesn't come with onions??? I told her that that was what drew my attention on the menu. She apologized and she agreed that it was very well done. At that point, it was late in the dinner and I had requested it be taken off the bill.

Eventually the manager stopped by and told me that people usually order burgers medium thinking it would be red or red pink. Mine was brown and that a medium burger should be pink in the center and that was what I expected. The burger I received had no hint of color and was completely brown. I thought this was a little insulting.

Overall, I enjoyed the appetizers and part of my wife's entrée and the ambience. But the manager allowing a waitress to be over sat with seven tables should never have happened.

Let me break down this review. The games section of Dave & Buster's gets 4 stars. The food & drinks section of Dave & Buster's gets ZERO stars. From the greasy luke warm french fries, to the undercooked pepperoni pizza bites, to the disgusting & tasteless "beef" sliders, to cold nachos, to custom craft cocktails that taste like kids juice boxes, to milk shakes that taste like liquified Cool Whip, I have not eaten at such an awful family dining establishment in years. Oh, & most the servers are clueless & inattentive snot nosed Gen Z kids who are more interested in talking to each other than serving their customers. If you want to go with friends & the kids to play a great variety of arcade games, then by all means, go to Dave & Buster's for a fun time. Just eat somewhere else before you go. PS: This is not a cheap night out friends. The game cards are expensive if you want to play a good amount of the games they have, & the disgusting & inedible food is darn expensive compared to most sports bars, where the food is a 100 times better & not as expensive.

Gosh darnit. This place is sweet in every sense of the word! 

Coming in on 12/23 was probably the craziest decision I've made in 2020. Boxes of pies, cookies and cupcakes stacked to the ceiling. Seemingly dozens of bakers buzzing around the shop icing, packing, and yes, baking to fill the incredible holiday demand! 

And with all that activity, the shop was bright, spotless, and the case was stocked with delicious cupcakes and cookies! 

I came to pick up some cookies for our neighbors, but I couldn't leave without a cupcake AND a cookie. The salted caramel cupcake was donning the most delectable sticky caramel swirl and and the gluten free chocolate brownie cookie looked so decadent I just couldn't say no!

Both were just as well received as I'd hoped. It's so nice to be able to support a local business and bring a smile to some special people at the same time!
Good spot, if you live in the area or happen to be there. Service a lil slow but food is good. BYOB is a good thing here.

I've passed by this place on 301 many times and always wondered if their food is good. Finally I tried it, and it is good! I had the rice with pork and black beans. It was delicious. The staff is friendly, and the restaurant was clean. Seem like a pretty popular place.  Will try it again.

So disappointed in Joe's today. Joes surprised me the first time I went because it's a drive through cafe/donut shop with really good hot food for breakfast. Today I received such horrible service I'll never allow myself to spend money with Joe's again. I went through the drive through and when trying to place my order I was told to drive up to the window without even ordering. I pull up to the window and sit for 10 mins without being acknowledged. I then notice the lady standing at the window taking orders on the headset apparently of the customers behind me. So I asked the lady did she realize she still had not taken my order while she was taking others behind me in line? She said she would get to me eventually she was getting them out the way first. What does that even mean. So I sat another 5 minutes no one speaking to me. I felt like they were so busy they were purposely ignoring me in the hopes that I would drive off. So I did. They literally did not want to serve me for what reason I don't know. Was my order too difficult? So I called the store to speak to the manager but I'm pretty sure the woman I spoke to wasn't the manager. I think She was lying because she didn't give her name. I'm really pissed because I loved Joe's before today!

I am a big fan of New York style pizza, and I have been to most places around. This is my go to spot, best across the board. Perfect crust, the sauce taste good, the toppings are fresh and the cheese melts perfectly for that all important elasticity. My son seems to enjoy the topping here more as well. He pulls them all off and eats them by themselves and still eats all the crust.
Courtney was an amazing waitress. Perfect dinner and perfect service. Filet was delicious. Lobster and scallops the same. Sides easily fed all 5 of us. Will return for our next special occasion.

This is a really great spot for a casual, local meal. As its name suggests, the restaurant is literally across the street from the train station, so it's super easy to find it and get there. 

Although the interior is plain, the restaurant makes up for it with its down to earth staff and great food. You can see the chefs hard at work in the kitchen and the wait staff were nonstop. I ordered the turkey sandwich on a bulkie roll, and it was huge! It came with lettuce and tomato, so a very classic sandwich overall. It was good, but what would have made it even better was if it came with avocado or grilled on a panini! Sweet potato fries were amazing. Not too salty and had the perfect crisp. 

It's not fancy or fluffy, but it's down to earth and you know you'll get a good homestyle meal here that all ages will enjoy.

My partner and I were looking for a new place to try after a long work week. We found a groupon for Azteca and decided to give it a try. When we walked in we were greeted by a friendly host and the chips and salsa were brought out immediately. Our waitress was very pleasant and prompt. I ordered the Azteca Quesadillas and my partner ordered the chicken enchiladas. Both dishes were good. My only complaint would be the rice and beans. They didn't have much flavor but everything else was delicious. I was impressed with the ambiance, service, and food.

I've tried pozole in many places. This spot has the best pozole around. I asked for extra Spicey and they delivered. The fish tacos el carbon were great my in-laws enjoyed. The blood orange margaritas definitely tasted great. The owner marcos if I'm not mistaken was very friendly. I'm from la/Oc area and was blown away by the food and service. My wife and I will be coming back just for the pozole. Thanks guys!

Heard about this place even before they opened.  Was intrigued.  102.5 The Bone mentions often, and I knew what I wanted there, based on them.  Finally went 10/2020.  Seated quickly, returned with napkin and silverware. Then nothing.  For 10 minutes...no one came to our table.  We left; went to a restaurant down the street...

Having lived in New Orleans I'm pretty picky about Cajun Creole food. This place is fantastic. From the fried alligator appetizer to the amaretto bread pudding finale I felt like I was back in the Big Easy!! Try it you won't regret it.

Delicious and a joy to sit at the kitchen counter and watch the food artists at work. Great vibe and many good things to eat.  Highly recommended if you are traveling solo and need a respite from hotel food and boring "fast casual" fare.
Eaten here about 3 times. Really enjoy the burrito I get each time, would like to explore the menu and try other things as well. Nice atmosphere and location as well.
We love Guppy's!  The staff and food are top notch and always willing to accommodate.  We highly recommend them.

Great place.  My wife, her cousin and myself stopped here for the first time and we love it!!! Will definitely be back here for food.  The prices are really good too.  Staff was very nice.  My wife and I had the French onion soul which I highly recommend it was on point.  We also had the hummus for an appetizer and it was really good.  The environment is really relaxing as well and love the art work on the walls.

Service was awful. Besides the waitress spilling a drink on one of the people in our party and doing nothing about it besides giving her some napkins and saying "oops". Then ignoring us most of our visit that we had to ask another waitress to get her twice. Good food but lousy service. I would only do take out there.

I had lunch in the "outdoor" patio that is seriously outfitted for distance, fresh air and all weather. We finally had to ask our server to turn off the heat because it was so toasty. We both loved out bloody Marys. They were on the sweet end with a seasoned salt in the rim. Yum! I real likes my decadent lobster bisque.  It was exceptional. I opted for the soup and half sandwich and really liked my half a fried chicken sandwich. I know this is a crazy high CAL lunch but at least it was a half a sandwich. My friend had the falafel and it really looked very good. She said it was very traditional and the best way. I look forward to attending this restaurant again in the future. The food was good and I felt safe.

More than tea! I'm not a tea drinker, so I didn't think there was anything here for me, but I was wrong. What a great place to pickup a quick and tasty lunch. I placed my oder online, which was very easy, and it was ready in 15 minutes - and this was on a Friday at noon! 
I ordered The Larson, which is more than enough to fill you. Lots of yummy pesto and I love the bread lightly toasted.
Not many quick lunch options in the area, so keep this place in mind.

This was my first time here and I am very pleased by the variety of healthy vegan options.  I got to sample before I made a choice.  My Moroccan chickpea bowl was hearty, warm and comforting for the cold rainy day.  It's easy to be gluten free without feeling like you're missing something.  I'm full and very satisfied.  I'll be back!
I've never had food like this before and what an experience. There are no words for how delicious and satisfying it was.I would definitely recommend this to everyone.

I went here one time for lunch and ate one dish. Therefore my review will be narrow in scope so I'm not going to hammer them in my rating. Clean restaurant, fast service, tiny bowl that looked like a small side salad with a few squares of tuna on it. This is a sushi place that added poke bowls to the menu because of the competition across the street. If you want a poke bowl do not choose this place. Not a good value for the money.

I have been going to this bdubs for awhile now and I always enjoy it more when I get to eat inside because the wings are so much bigger for some reason.  Every time I order To go my wings are the size of a Tyson chicken breading ball and usually lacking a good amount of sauce. I always get the same thing and every time they mess up giving me both blue cheese and southwest ranch. Really wish they would just make bigger wings or give you more wings for the lack of how tiny most of them are. Still love bdubs but sad that the to go food is so much less appreciated.

Engine No. 9 has always been one of our favorites and we've been going since they opened. You can always count on a good cap menu/selection. They have fantastic burgers, some of the best in St Pete, but our favorite is the Sriracha Wings. Sooooo good! And the perfect heat. The only time we have had any level of disappointment, was once during this covered nonsense, when we got some wings to go. We were introducing some family to them for the first time, and they did not live up to our normal expectation. But one time is not enough to keep us from going back (or ordering to go!), again and again! If burgers are your thing this place will not disappoint. Our favorites are the Demi-God (yuuuuuum!), and the Lower 9th. We love a little heat/spice!! For something a little more 'tame' try the Black 'n Bleu.

I have driven by so may times, but never thought to try it out because there are already so many pizza places in town. I finally decided to try it out because they offer an axxess deal, and boy, was I pleasantly surprised. The pizza is delicious, and you can't beat the prices! I tried a thin pizza and a pan pizza, and they were both cooked to perfection. While I was there, I noticed the affordable prices of salads, ice cream cookie sandwiches, and regular sandwiches. I can't wait  to try those as well. This is definitely my new go-to pizza place in town!

We had a wonderful dinner here, food, wine and outstanding service plus the ambience was special. We had a miserable flight from Florida, Frontier 5 hours late. The weather was equally poor . We stayed at the hotel and had looked forward to trying one of the Yelp recommended restaurants. Poor weather and Yelp reviews made our decision to have an unwinding dinner with a short walk to the Station and it turned out to be a perfect evening.

Very friendly staff! The host and server were wonderful. I got the eggs benedict with hash browns and my boyfriend got the country fried steak with potatoes and eggs. The food was amazing and came out very quick. Very cute place as well!

Good food, Indian with Chipotle or Naf Naf concept, a bit hit or miss on the rice and curry, but always a hit on the meat and veggies. 
Service is good, quantity could be more for the base items of rice, daal. Overall, a good, quick place providing healthy eating options.
Awesome place for breakfast with friendly staff and it's open 24 hours a day. My favorite is the double blueberry pancakes and my wife loves the omelets.

Great Mexican Food - at last!  Moved from N California four years ago to M Tenn and have been looking for good authentic Mexican food since. I was totally satisfied with attentiveness of staff, friendliness and best of all the flavor of the food. Way to go!  I will be back and update this in a few months as I look for consistency of staff and food.
Ordered a cheese pizza from here for delivery. Was pleasantly surprised. Good sauce, NY-style crust and the sauce even had a bit of kick to it.

My order was egg drop soup, crab Rangoons, almond chicken and beef and peppers. Got my order for pick up and everything was ready in 15 minutes. Food was amazing I have absolutely zero complaints. Would definitely recommend.

I believe this place has amazing potential. I ordered not the fish and chicken with turnip greens/ Mac & cheese as the side. Fish was "bomb"- I had the whiting. It was very flavorful. However; the chicken wings were very bland and lacked the crunchiness I prefer. Also the greens were bland, like they came out of the can. Mac was ok. I will definitely visit a couple more times to get a baseline but I am hoping that the chicken is more flavorful next time.

This must be the best place for Sushi/Sashimi bar none! I ordered the Octopus Salad, and the Sashimi Moriawase, my wife ordered the Unagi Maki. I must say I am not a big fan of Sushi which is why I ordered the Sashimi, but the Unagi Maki changed my mind. I guess if its done well, it will be delicious, as I found myself picking off my wife's order. Octopus was sliced very thin. Even the Green Tea was excellent, never tasted such delicious tea. We ordered the Japanese Cheesecake that came with fresh sliced strawberries, very thin sliced White Chocolate wafers, and blueberries which were very light and airy and not dense like a NY Cheesecake. Recommend you make a reservation during the weekends. We visited last Saturday and were told there is a 2 1/2 hour wait and it was around 6 pm. Angela our server was excellent.

Had a wonderful experience celebrating a Birthday. The scallops, hummus and Brussels sprouts were amazing
Highly recommend this restaurant

The inside is nice and location is good but I don't get the appeal. Service was nothing to write home about and the food did not match the price. I got the hot chicken dish and maybe ate half of it and took the rest home. We may go back for a second try but the first visit just left us wanting more...

Was excited to finally find somewhere close to my house and somewhere that had so many great reviews. I don't know if it was an off night which every place of business has but the service was just okay. I sat at the sushi bar, the chef and server were having a disagreement right in front of me which kind of made me uncomfortable because it was about closing, my drink never got refilled, and as soon as the chef handed me my sushi roll the server brought me my check I felt very rushed and unwelcome. Like I said I know every place has their off nights, my sushi was good but nothing mind blowing. I will give the place another try and hope that my second experience is better than my first.

We were in the mood last night for some authentic tacos and remembered being introduced to this place years ago by friends.  It was just as good as we remembered from before.  Each of the tacos we got (asada, al pastor, carnitas, and pollo) were very flavorful!  We also got the carne asada fries that were awesome and a HUGE serving!  The meat was amazing and the sauces were great too!
The drive through was efficient, professional, and friendly and most importantly got our order exactly right!
We'll definitely be back!

first time coming to this place- I follow them on instagram and although I am hardcore chipotle fan I thought i would give it a try. 

when we walked in the line was really long. i figured it wouldn't take that long because, well, it always moves really fast at chipotle. that was not the case here. it was painfully slow. the girls they have working there are not trained to be efficient, cleanly, or timely. it's embarrassing. 

finally got up to the front and I hear her tell the guy in front of me they are "out" of steak and pork. are you joking me?? why wasn't there a sign or someone letting people in line know that their two most popular meats are not available?? I asked her if they were going to offer some incentive to come back, such as a coupon to the people that have been waiting over 20 minutes to find that they do not have what they waited for. she shrugged and said, "they will be ready in 20 minutes if you want to wait." um NO sweetie, I just waited 20 minutes already. you should have told people! (i didn't say this, i just asked about the coupon and she said we could wait. i'm not about to confront a 17 year old over carne asada.) she didn't give a crap. the guy in front of me and his two teenagers left because of this. no one apologized. no one cared. no manager in sight. only teenagers who didn't even bat an eye. 

I got up to the front finally and WOW! you have to be kidding me- the place was ATROCIOUS. I'm talking so messy I was disgusted. the meats and beans wer
Amazing! Must try the bread pudding. Well actually try it all, everything's freaking amazing.

Food was fresh and good as we ordered off the menu. It was perfectly seasoned chow menu, Orange chicken, and broccoli beef that needed no extra soy sauce at all. Service was great and server was very friendly.
We just stumbled on Liberty Hall shopping in Lambertville NJ. I highly recommend the pizza. Read the two pages on how and why the make the pizza the way they do. Btw the salad was amazing too.
Their dumplings and wonton soup were disgusting, thick and doughy, and the wontons weren't even fully cooked. I've made better dumplings in my own kitchen and I'm a white guy.

As stated in many reviews the triple play is the best way to go. I really like the spicy crispy shrimp tacos but the ahi ones are great too. Fast and friendly service. The sauce they give you is super spicy.

Yuno Sushi is such a great casual place for delicious sushi in Nolensville. Their prices are amazing and the service is(mostly) good. I recommend the Nigori Sake, a cloudy sake with a reasonable price. They have great miso soup (I swear it cures all ailments) and house salad which are great ideas for starters. I also love their edamame and, If you like heat, the spicy edamame.  My favorite roll  is deep fried  and it's the Double Crunch. The Drunken tiger is also really delish! If you're looking for a great deal, go for lunch and get the Bulgogi!
Love this place! Best wings in town! Friendly staff! Great beer selection.  Lexi behind the bar is always wonderful!

This is our 4th trip to Treasure Island and every time we have ordered pizza take out from Britt's at least twice. The pizza has been superb and always ready at time of pickup. The staff is friendly and courteous as well. We are looking forward to our next order and highly recommend the Hawaiian.

To be honest, I'm shocked this place has such good reviews. I work nearby and today was my first time. I got a salad with barely any lettuce that was drenched in dressing. I also got a 6 piece sushi roll that tasted super fishy. I sat next to a table of girls. One of them complained her vegetables were cold. Instead of the server offering to replace them, she argued with the customer. Then she sent 2 other waitresses over to inspect the plate. They both grabbed it. The girl told them she wasn't going to eat it and I don't blame her. I'm going to stick to my usual Sakura sushi in Bellevue and I won't be back to Ninki. Do yourself a favor and go there instead! It's sooo good and consistent! :)

Wonderful breakfast spot! Patio dining was great with the breeze in this FL heat.  

Ordered the Spinach Scramble with mushrooms added. It was prepared to perfection... not too hard scrambled and not runny. The cheese was still gooey. The potatoes were crunchy on outside, yet soft on inside. 

I will definitely go to this location again.

Don't f**k around! 
Just head straight here for the spiciest yet tasty seafood in New Orleans.

Oh and I finally got to have 'The Boot' here after a long time. 

Crab legs  
Crawfish  
Abita beer  
Gulf Shrimp   
Fried Soft shell crab  
Turkey Necks  
Gloves on

This food is so good.  Our local choice for Mexican food, we drive past a few other places to get here as it is 15 minutes away from our home.  We like clean and fresh food!  This is the only takeout we have had since covid started.

Visited on 4/3/2020:
Opened for take out order online (appears to be full menu & easy to navigate) & pick up on their bakery side, still have a selection of bakery goods & daily roasted ducks/pig Togo. Their door says delivery through chowbus though I'm not familiar. We ordered a whole roasted duck for $24 (TIP: ask for extra sauce), a few dim sum items & a couple sweet bakeries. Overall, fair traditional Chinese food, friendly cashier, outer appearance showed some aging but clean interior (bakery side) and has protective glass to protect their employees.
The place is active and very nice inside.  The burger was a good size and cooked just right.  Kids pizza was almost adult size and the fruit was fresh.  Service was spot on and friendly !

Great flavors, awesome beans and cilantro rice, nice staff, clean food and restaurant. The Green mole was perfect and so was the toastada. We found a new favourite Mexican place. Oh and the salsa had the perfect bite!!! Don't change.

Wonderful food! The only problem we had was with the sauce on our gyro wrap. We don't like the taste of the sauce. When ordering we asked for no sauce but instead they added extra sauce. The potatoes had a wonderful flavor.

Ate at Panera Bread. Had the 1/2 turkey,Apple,cheese sandwich w/ small bowl of N.E. clam chowder. Delicious!! Not sure if the menu stated what kind of bread the sandwich comes on. I may have missed it. It was tasty- looked like a seeded rye or wheat with cranberries and nuts in it. My reason for not giving 5 stars is that if the bread was not described and I had a food allergy, it could have been a real bad experience. Meal always tastes fresh each time I've eaten there.

The korean fried cauliflower alone would be enough to ordinarily warrant a 4 star review.  It is by far one of the best appetizers I have ever had.  However, the overall experience was tainted due to their very poor ability to handle the coexistence of COVID-19 and a crowded Saturday night.  They had solid attempts to keep their employees and customers safe by continuing to offer curbside carryout and requiring employees to have masks (keyword there being HAVE - not wear correctly).  We pulled up for curbside carryout after ordering and paying online to find that there were no spots available.  So, we decided to attempt to go in for our order only to find that there was a ridiculous amount of people not wearing masks waiting for tables and for carryout with multiple customer complaints coming from every direction.  The takeout cashier had a mask, but was wearing it so that it only covered his chin (last I checked, our chins are not the part of our face that produce germ particles into the air) and was confronted by another customer for wearing gloves that were not being changed after handling everyone's money.  Hey Cheesecake Factory - just having your employees use hand sanitizer after each customer with no gloves would probably be more sanitary.  Meanwhile, another customer was complaining to the manager (who, by the way, was standing right next to this chin-mask-wearing employee without saying a word) that their carryout order that they had been waiting for over an hour fo
Love their cheesesteaks and fries. Go to place in Drexel Hill. Friendly service.

We stayed at the Hyatt Next door and decided to walk over since it was late and we were tired. 

Great service, friendly staff, and COLD BEER! 

Chili was ok, wouldn't order it again. No beans and way too much tomato sauce. 

Turkey club hit the spot. Fresh sliced turkey and I love they grilled the turkey before building the sandwich. 

The fried Mac and cheese appetizer is A MUST!

Went to Ghini's for Saturday morning brunch carry out, the lovely girl who took my Bloody Mary order did a great job up selling me two carafes of bloodies....delicious! Went to the bakery side and controlled myself to only purchase 2 croissants and 1 cinnamon roll (no raisins) Keith hates raisins. They were delicious and perfect! Please go support them and all our local restaurants!

Recommend to stay away from this dive. I would have only given it a half star if I could.   Though the reviews and articles all say that this is a "local favorite" for the best gumbo, I beg to differ.  No self-respecting NOLA local would eat here.  The Chicken Andouille gumbo was just so so and it wasn't even hot.  Barely warm, actually.  A tad bit on the salty side probably because that's the only flavor they add.  It's doesn't even look appetizing.  But when the crawfish étouffée arrived, I was all done with this place.  It was gross - fishy, salty and was nothing more than a bowl of slop topped with dollop of rice.  When our server asked how everything was, and my husband's reply started as "meh," but our server cut him off with his shrugged shoulders as he said okay and walked away.  We had to call him back to tell him our meals were horrible and then he was full of attitude.  We ended up leaving hungry and grabbed a slice of pizza which was far better than the Gumbo Shop.  There are so many other places in the French Quarter to dine, skip this one!

Stopped by here on a Saturday night for the first time. They had live music which was pretty good. A lot of folks on bikes came and went, seemed like a pretty friendly atmosphere for locals. Made me miss having a Harley, I'll definitely be back. The Buffalo chicken dip was great.
So happy to have a local coffee shop in the neighborhood. The coffee and food is delicious and the staff are so friendly.

I got the Al Pastor tacos.

The tortillas were fresh and hot. The pork was well executed, though could have been slightly more tender. The pineapple and pork flavors were well balanced. The tacos came with a big cooked onion which was very savory and nicely executed.

Took way too long for an order.  Took an hour and 20 minutes after the order for it to be ready.  They forgot the sweet and sour sauce.  Order very early on a Saturday otherwise there will be a long line and a longer wait.  Food is great.

My second visit. So delicious. I had the crunchy Thai wrap with chicken. My dining companion had the funky chicken pesto on ciabatta. Both delicious and fresh. He enjoyed his black bean soup. The iced tea was fresh and delicious too. I may go back in the morning. I love it so much. The people are lovely and seem to enjoy their work. Even the customers waiting at a busy lunch hour seemed happy. A good chill vibe. Well done!

I went to Gauchos with a meet-up group on a Tuesday night.   The meat was very good but the salad bar was a bit of a joke and I hesitate calling it a salad bar.  If you are a true carnivore and could care less about anything else give them a shot. I was a bit surprised to see it nestled in a strip Plaza between George's Neighborhood Grill that I love and La Hacienda, both with huge followings.

tried the oxtail only ( no rice etc)
-fall off the bone texture
-flavored well
-satisfied my oxtail fix

will be back
Very good, fresh sushi with many options and combinations. Kani salad was great, the shooting stars were interesting and a nice change than typical shrimp dumplings. Great covid-19 setup.

Pho ben used to be a regular part of our dining out rotation. Sadly they've really fallen off. The last few visits (dine in), we waited at least an hour for our food.  Certain items we tried to order we were told would take 60 minutes to make and to pick something else (papaya salad... 60 minutes?). 

It finally got to the point on a recent visit that we cancelled the remaining dishes because half the table had received the food and finished their meals before others received anything. 

A gentleman approached our table to apologize upon learning that we cancelled our remaining orders. He said that the rent is very high and they don't have the staff to make things run smoothly. 

For now, we'll have to patronize other viet restaurants in the area and maybe give them another chance in the future.

Stopped by here with my girlfriend about 2 weeks ago.  We had a couple drinks and some appetizers. I cant remember the servers name but she was very friendly and attentive and she was the only one there. We had the roasted curry cauliflower and the fried plantains with guava reduction, both were very good. Definitely gonna stop by again soon.

Ok Please do yourself a favor and get here as quickly as possible!  I have been to Venice, Italy multiple times and this place is a wonderful representation of the cuisine and warm hospitality of one of the greatest cities in Europe. Homemade pastas, I've tried four and the squid ink pasta is as delicious and authentic as your are going to get in Italy. Portions are generous and shareable. I ordered an extra pizza just to bring home....lol All the desserts are homemade in house and I've eaten dozens of tiramisu varieties all over the world, the pistachio version here is as good as any.  I have been to Michelin star restaurants in multiple countries and Aqua Alta puts many of them to shame with the freshness of ingredients and care in preparation. Seriously, today for lunch I had whole grilled branzino, super trendy I know, but this fish was fresh from Greece (according to the owner and I believe him) served on a platter of amazing crispy vegetables sautéed in olive oil.  I've never gotten bested by a fish before, but it was literally enough for three people and I had to take half of it home.  Amazing version of the famous spritz cocktail so good my wife had two!  I only take the time to leave reviews for exemplary restaurants and this one is truly a gem.  I think they also won best dish in safety harbor? I'll keep going back until I've tried everything, not a single miss so far :) Grazie Mille por la Grappa!
Food was amazing and service was unexpectedly fast. Our waitress was really nice and gave us great recommendations on her favorites. The baked gulf shrimp tortellini was absolutely amazing!

Restaurant looks very unassuming from outside. Once inside the, the restaurant is very clean and tastefully decorated. I found this restaurant on Yelp. My daughter is a vegetarian and we are always looking for new restaurants near heat college that have choices for vegetarians instead of two items. This place had a multitude of options. We had the vegetable  Momo, chicken Satay, Veg Thenthuk, chicken lo mein, vegetable lo mein, and Beef Shatrak. Everything was delicious. The staff was very friendly and were eager to assist us when we asked for recommendations. We finished our meal off with a shared banana tempura which was a great way to finish our experience. We will definitely be returning to this hidden gem.

We find the most current renovation the staff can be snobby at times. They refuse to seat smaller parties if all they have is a 6/8 top free. We asked to be seated at a free table and was denied. Food is usually decent but because of staff we will not be returning. Couples should stay away.

Highly recommended.  We went for a late lunch for a family of 4 after spending the morning at de Soto's park only 15-20 mins away, around 3 PM, walked in when they just opened for the business day.  This place is amazingly aunthentic Japanese and with super good vibe and environment.  Suchi melts in your mouth.  Soups are delicious, never tasted something so savory smooth before in my life.  Teriyaki Stake was amazing, cooked to perfection with red wine and Asian spices.  Shrimp rice is more like a Spanish Paella,  plenty, fresh and beautiful to taste.  Deserts and service are also top notch.  Congrats and thank you  thank you thank you to the staff and owners which I assume includes a hard working classy Japanese lady that would greet you at the door step.  We will come back!

Buyers beware. I would not purchase from this location until you can actually get inside to see what they are giving you. I went there yesterday and what I was given appeared to be scraps of chicken and not actual pieces of chicken. I believe that because you can't see what they are doing the quality of the chicken is subpar. GO AT YOUR OWN RISK!!!
Thunderbird pizza has the best buffalo chicken pizza on the planet. Also the staff is always very friendly despite how busy they are!

So as far a Boise Idaho is concerned, this place is awesome.  I have had better, but again, I was in Boise.  

The menu is extensive, the food is fresh, the place is clean and the service is spot on!  They are always busy, so go early, or expect to wait a few minutes for a table.

Everything we had was really good (Curry, noodles, the green beans with pork were our favorite).  The spice level is a little off to me.  They grade it n 1, 2, 3 & 4 levels (4 being the spiciest), but we found little spice and tried up to level 3.  I will only order 4 from now on (I like it a little hotter than others and 3 had very mild heat).

Will I go back 100% sure I will.
Tacos aren't bad but not amazing, didn't provide the red sauce cause they were out of it

checked in late and enjoyed the night playing slots, when it was time to get some s heres the treasure we found.....they offered us a new new room thats the good thing but moving all our stuff at 5am is the sad part. housekeeping was nice enough to bring us fresh sheets and blankets.

I just ate a cinnamon donut hole from this place and looked down at my cup and there are several MOLDY donuts!! I returned the 4 cups of donut holes I purchased immediately. I wish I would have taken a picture! This was my first experience with Donut Daze and my last. Today is National Donut Day and this place is completely dead. But I just passed Guru donuts and there is a line out the door...this should tell you something. How dissapointing! This place is not going to last long on 8th street, unfortunately.

So this review isn't about B Dubs food.  We all know what their food will be like.  It's always good but never great.  Consistently decent at every location. 

We were at the beach all day and on the way home had to feed the 5 kids and the wife.  We saw BDubs and stopped in.  

The place was empty so we thought great.  Should be a in and out.  

I only tip 15% when I get terrible service and it's the least I will tip not matter what.  I normally tip 20 to 25% because I bartended and waited tables in the 90s.  Today I tipped 18% but only because she did a good job providing us what we needed.  If she was half way nice or didn't seem bothered by our presence,  I would have tipped my regular 20+%.  

I'm not sure what we did to Nicole but she made us feel like we inconvenienced her from jump. It was uncalled for and really pissed us off.  We watched her with other guests and she was fine, but not us.  Actually she became a little nicer when we had to ask the manager to correct an incorrect order.  After that her treatment of us mildly improved.  

She never apologize for ringing an order in incorrectly or said anything when our 1 daughters desert came out cater everyone else finished there's.  

Nicole, you work in the service industry so you might want to check that tude.  It cost you money tonight. .  Not sure what we did to Piss you off but My kids have manners and I always say please and thank you myself.

Well I was doing security down the road so I thought I'd pick me up some dinner. I go through the culvers drive-through I asked for a bacon cheeseburger combo with a sweet tea I asked for extra crispy bacon I even said burn it. I asked for mustard ketchup pickles and lettuce on my sandwich. And before all you people out there start yelling you check your food before you pull away from the drive-through well you don't get your food at the drive-through you pull forward and they bring it out to you and by the time they brought it out to me they were closed. Let's start with my sweet tea ,no I did not get it! I got a Pepsi I haven't drank soda in four years and I wasn't going to start tonight. Onto the sandwich not only was the bacon not crispy it was raw. And As for the toppings it looks like they were trying to dress a white castle burger.

I've been to this location a few times, and the food has been really good... HOWEVER!!!!! Tonight's experience was ABSOLUTELY horrible... My wife and I arrived at 7:30pm to grab a table for 6 of us to celebrate her 35th birthday. We had invited three of our neighbors for a "first time experience!!".. Once we were seated it took the watress Julie approximately 25 minutes to initially get to our table to simply state, "I'm sorry guys, give me three more minutes and I'll be back to get your drink orders!" After another 5-10 minutes, she came back to retrieve 6 drink orders which consisted of 5 waters and 1 tea.... She then proceeded to take another 15-20 minutes to take our orders.. Once taken, we still had yet to receive our beverages.... TEN MINUTES LATER we received our beverages.. At this point, we were STILL waiting our food... It took approximately AN HOUR AND 15 MINUTES TO RECEIVED OUR FOOD!!!!!!!! When asked to speak to a manager, Kim the assistant manager came.... She reported (paraphrased), "Well. Since you wanted your fish fried hard, it can take up to 40 minutes to fry it hard! That COULD be the reason that it took so long." ANYONE in their RIGHT frame of mind knows that a piece of fish fried for 40 minutes is NO LONGER EDIBLE!!!!! It took my sister to go up to the front to grab the attention of the manager after asking her about compensation for us to get a legit answer.... It also appears that Julie the waitress lied on Kim when she brought back a message to the ta

Their brick & mortar location is open at the corner of St. Mary's and Grande, and the food is inspired! Bring cash for now, because you don't want to walk away without trying the Rajas con crema taco, and the Ahogado shrimp taco empanada style with their special green sauce. Small but mighty with inviting outdoor seating.

First time I've been to a Jason's Deli. Thoroughly enjoyed it. Had the California Club, fresh, served fast and hit the spot. Staff was very friendly, helpful. Complimentary crackers, mini muffins, garlic toast and soft serve ice cream was a plus. Prices are very reasonable for what you get.

The best Mexican! We live 45 mins away and we will travel to come here. We were there tonight. Had margaritas, three amigos which is chips salsa quest and guacamole. I had the mini Mexican pizza OMG! My boyfriend had the Mexican rolls which are three small burritos deep fried, literally a Mexican egg roll WOW! I have had the chimichanga which is fantastic. Must check this place out. But be warned there is always a wait but I promise it is more than worth the wait!

Horrible, bad food just got the dip found a small Hair on the chip and one chip was covered in dry barbecue which is absolutely gross, dip was obviously microwaved and to top it off the whole place smelled like rusting drainage (not exaggerating l, see for yourself)

I would advice not to go there if you don't wanna get sick.

Came in to sit at the bar for an afternoon cocktail. The drinks were delicious- especially the hot apple cider! 
The bartender was friendly and attentive to our group of 4. He also was happy to explain some of the recipes and spirits when we asked. 
The bar, restaurant, and bathrooms were all very clean. The location is great for additional street parking right off Virginia ave.

Was expecting the usual Red Lobster experience, but was pleasantly surprised to find an incredibly cheerful and friendly staff which made the experience exceptional. There was a young man who was the host who went out of his way to be helpful and enthusiastic about the restaurant. I would definitely go there again.

I LOVE this sushi spot. Always really quality fish, reasonable prices, and Joseph is such a knowledgeable and friendly sushi chef. Try and go as often as I can. Such a welcomed addition to north phillys food scene
Soooooo goood!!! New York style pizza. Super fresh. Friendly staff. Definitely recommend!

We had dinner there last night. We were seated promptly and accommodations were made for my husband's walker. The lobster dip appetizer, White clam chowder and lobster ravioli were fantastic. The rolls were incredible. There was a problem with my husband's steak and we told our server Brendan. His service was really exceptional. He went out of his way to speak to the manager quickly and made sure we were satisfied. The food and Brendan's service are reasons we will be back.

UPDATE: I had a second chance to come dine in weeks after they had been open for a while. We had a wonderful time with dinner for 4 (1 having Celiacs). We all tried a lot of items off of the menu and everything was superb and they have a LOT of gluten free items. I was additionally impressed that they now had gluten free bread, pasta, and pizza and the meals were being prepared in a dedicated area to prevent gluten cross contamination. I was told the pizza was also cooked separately to deter gluten cross contamination. I really enjoyed the pasta dish I had with shrimp and look forward to trying more. The raw oysters are no longer on the menu, but the roasted oysters are and you can request them to be made gluten free. The fried calamari is cooked in a dedicated fryer, it was absolutely delicious and thats hard to get GF just anywhere. Now that its no longer "opening week" service was good, the restaurant was full, but not too busy, and the atmosphere was great. Our 2nd visit was in February and I would definitely return and recommend to anyone with Celiacs or a gluten allergy or no allergy at all.

When in philly don't  forget to stop here for your Philly cheesesteak. Went to a concert with friends and this place was packed but the service was quick. They had stools to sit on inside and the sweet potato fries were awesome.

So, this week Mr. B's Southern Cuisine has popped up on my Instagram.  I had never heard of this restaurant & it's been around for 3 years. Wow!!

Right when I walked in, I was greeted & I ordered the pancake platter.  It comes with two huge pancakes, bacon & scrambled eggs. 

I like the look of the restaurant on the outside & outside.  Nice music playing & very inviting inside.  

This afternoon, my brother actually wanted to go there & I took him there.  While waiting for our take out, Mr. B showed up & he is very nice.  He cares very much about keeping his customers happy.

I had the chicken and waffles which is seasoned very good. Also, I ordered the peach cobbler & it's yummy. 

So, I will be back.

The spot has a nice atmosphere and was conveniently quick for someone looking for decent food. I ordered the chicken gyro with the white sauce and some hot sauce. I didn't make it a meal since they only give you a handful of fries. I liked the taste and the flavors but I wasn't full afterwards. Probtshiuld have ordered the meal I guess. For the price of one gyro at this place, you can get 2 decent gyros from Arby's. ‍ I would suggest bigger portions to bring back customers.
